changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: MODEL_SPEC_V1_SCHEMA_RETIREMENT_BLOCKED: migrate or archive v1 rows and clear legacy columns before deployment
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'modeling_model_spec'::regclass AND conname = 'fk_modeling_model_spec_object'
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = current_schema() AND tablename = 'modeling_model_spec' AND indexname IN ('idx_modeling_model_spec_object', 'idx_modeling_model_spec_process')

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname IN ( 'ck_model_spec_contract_version', 'ck_model_spec_v2_identity', 'ck_model_spec_v2_type_context', 'ck_model_spec_v2_json_shapes', 'ck_model_spec_revision_contract_version', 'ck_model_spec_revision_payload' ) AND conrelid IN ('modeling_model_spec'::regclass, 'modeling_model_spec_revision'::regclass)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_standard_binding) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_business_object)
SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2

SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL OR process_id IS NOT NULL OR dimensions IS NOT NULL OR metrics IS NOT NULL OR dbt_project_key IS NOT NULL OR dbt_unique_id IS NOT NULL OR legacy_ref IS NOT NULL OR legacy_refs IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_revision WHERE contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR spec_json IS NOT NULL

changeSet.comment: Contract the ModelSpec ledger to the canonical v2 schema after all legacy rows, legacy columns and compatibility tables have been proven empty.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE modeling_business_object, modeling_model_spec, modeling_model_spec_revision, modeling_standard_binding IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

DO $$ BEGIN IF ( (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_standard_binding) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_business_object) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL OR process_id IS NOT NULL OR dimensions IS NOT NULL OR metrics IS NOT NULL OR dbt_project_key IS NOT NULL OR dbt_unique_id IS NOT NULL OR legacy_ref IS NOT NULL OR legacy_refs IS NOT NULL) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_revision WHERE contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR spec_json IS NOT NULL) ) <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_SPEC_V1_SCHEMA_RETIREMENT_LOCKED_RECHECK_FAILED'; END IF; END $$;

ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec ALTER COLUMN contract_version SET DEFAULT 2; ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec_revision ALTER COLUMN contract_version SET DEFAULT 2;
ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_contract_version CHECK (contract_version = 2); ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_v2_identity CHECK ( contract_version = 2 AND plan_id IS NOT NULL AND domain_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'DESIGNING', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_PUBLISH', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') AND current_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND btrim(idempotency_key) <> '' AND idempotency_request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND idempotency_response_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(idempotency_response_snapshot) = 'object' ); ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_v2_type_context CHECK ( contract_version = 2 AND (model_type = 'FACT' OR business_activity_ref IS NULL) AND ( model_type <> 'APPLICATION' OR status = 'DRAFT' OR ( consumption_scenario IS NOT NULL AND btrim(consumption_scenario) <> '' ) ) AND (model_type = 'APPLICATION' OR consumption_scenario IS NULL) AND ( fact_shape IS NULL OR fact_shape IN ('TRANSACTION', 'PERIODIC_SNAPSHOT', 'ACCUMULATING_SNAPSHOT') ) ); ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_v2_json_shapes CHECK ( contract_version = 2 AND (grain_json IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(grain_json) = 'object') AND (time_semantics IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(time_semantics) = 'object') AND (fields IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(fields) = 'array') AND (source_refs IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(source_refs) = 'array') AND (depends_on IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(depends_on) = 'array') AND (dimension_refs IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(dimension_refs) = 'array') AND (metric_refs IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(metric_refs) = 'array') AND (standard_bindings IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(standard_bindings) = 'array') AND (generation_strategy IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(generation_strategy) = 'object') ); ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_revision_contract_version CHECK (contract_version = 2); ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_revision_payload CHECK ( contract_version = 2 AND snapshot_json IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(snapshot_json) = 'object' AND content_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' );
